LESSON: MARRIAGE • PURPOSE OF MARRIAGE • CONDITIONS FOR MARRIAGE • RIGHTS AND RESPONSIBILITIE S OF HUSBAND AND WIFE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relationship)
Topic 6.1: Marriage • Purpose of marriage • Conditions for marriage • Rights and responsibilitie s of husband and wife
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Marriage • Purpose of marriage • Conditions for marriage • Rights and responsibilitie s of husband and wife, part of Muamalat (Social Relationship) in Grade 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is marriage important in Islam? 2. What are the rights of a husband/wife in Islam?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on the purpose of marriage and share in class,

2. discuss the conditions for marriage and make notes,

3. research on rights and responsibilities of a husband and wife in marriage and make class presentations

4. dramatise rights and responsibilities in marriage. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the purpose of marriage and share in class,
2. discuss the conditions for marriage and make notes,
3. research on rights and responsibilities of a husband and wife in marriage and make class presentations
4. dramatise rights and responsibilities in marriage. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Marriage • Purpose of marriage • Conditions for marriage • Rights and responsibilitie s of husband and wife together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: as learners share new ideas during dramatization and research on the rights and responsibilities

in marriage.

• Self-efficacy: self-awareness as learners develops skills when dramatizing rights and responsibilities in marriage.

• Learning to Learn: the skill of developing relationships by sharing learnt knowledge during a discussion on the purpose of

marriage in groups.

Values:
• Love: Caring as learners dramatise the rights and responsibilities in marriage.

• Unity: fairness in sharing available resources during group activities in class such as dramatization.

• Social Justice: cooperation as learners dramatise the rights and responsibilities in marriage.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life Skills: effective communication as the learners research on the rights and the responsibilities in marriage and make class

presentations.

Link to other subjects:

Social Studies: as the learner discusses the purpose of marriage and relates to types of marriage in Social Studies.
